name: Proper Orthogonal Decomposition / Snapshot POD
summary: Construct low-dimensional basis functions approximating high-dimensional simulation snapshots.
core_idea: Compute dominant modes of snapshot covariance or an SVD and project state fields into that basis.
innovation: Provides a data-efficient reduced coordinate space for surrogate modeling and inverse problems.
limitations: Truncated subspaces may poorly represent out-of-distribution dynamics.
Accuracy depends strongly on snapshot coverage.

start_here.focus: How flow snapshots define dominant modes and a reduced representation.

curation_note: Core method concept and checked source(s) recorded; suggested readings remain advisory and may be revised.
